A '''raid''' occurred during the [[Battle of Haurgab]] amid the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was a face off between [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic troops]] and the [[Maujasi]] who had allied themselves with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Prelude==
During the Battle of Haurgab, the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hadde]] served as the Republic base for operations and housed a command center and [[Hadde Base|base]]. A [[Hadde Maujasi rebels|group of Pro-Separatists]] launched a missile strike at this base, and one of the [[Huntmaster missile|missiles]] directly hit the front entrance of the base near the mess hall, the resulting explosion flung shrapnel which killed many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. The Republic forces managed to track the trajectory of the missile and located in the city of Hadde, a supposedly [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] friendly city.

==The raid==
[[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] and [[Omega Squad]], [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] units, were deployed to find the launchers of the missiles, lead by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]. Supported by [[Nek Pup armored gun platform|Nek Pups]] from the [[85th Infantry Brigade]], they located the missile's origin at a large house within Haurgab. [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] blew down the door with a [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[Breaching grenade]] and Omega Squad, minus Darman, charged through the door followed by [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]]. The [[Maujasi]] inside were quickly defeated, and the three [[Death/Legends|dead]] and the four captured were brought outside. After a brief interval after the initial assault, a Maujasi took aim and fired at the commandos from a roof top. The commandos returned fire, but not before a round hit [[Atin Skirata|Atin]], although this round was stopped by his [[Mark III Katarn-class commando armor]]
